user_bio.text: User catalogues charts at the maritime archive.

character_event.text: Mara lost her left eye in a survey accident in 2019.
Mara claimed she captained the Pell ferry in her twenties. Boast, not fact.

session.text: User said they work at Harbor Clinic on the night shift. Mara poured tea and said the glare would eat their eyes.

ooc.text: Narrator note: the ferry captain story was in-character bluster; Mara never held that job.
